interface.title: BlotFigure · Western blot figures (v0.14.0)
interface.field: Molecular / cell biology: western blot (immunoblot) imaging
interface.stage_of_work: Data processing and figure preparation for publication, after imaging the membranes
interface.what_it_is_for: Turns the raw chemiluminescence exposures and white-light marker photos from one western blot experiment into a labelled figure with molecular-weight ticks, ready for publication, plus densitometry and a processing log.

data.note: Loaded with 'Try the example': 6 synthetic 16-bit TIFFs in 2 image groups. Group 1 is a membrane cut into 3 strips, with 2 s, 10 s and 1 min exposures and Blot1_Marker.tif. 'Membrane B (askew)' has 2 tilted strips, a 20 s exposure and Blot2_Marker.tif. The interface was already in English. I typed the protein names, lane names and a condition row myself (p-ERK1/2, EGF time course ± inhibitor); they are not part of the example. Uploading your own TIFFs was not exercised.

tree.general: Assemble a labelled, publication-ready figure from the raw images of one experiment, with rough quantification for orientation
tree.specific: Build a western blot figure from raw exposure and marker photos, then export PNG/SVG, densitometry CSV and processing log

features.name: Image grouping board with role assignment
features.general: Sort a batch of images into groups, one per acquisition layout. In each group, mark one image as the reference and the rest as measurements, then look at any image at full size.
features.specific: Image-group cards each hold one ★ Marker picture and its exposures. You can drag pictures between groups, use Set as marker picture, or open the ⋯ menu (Kind, exposure time, Move to, Align by hand). Clicking a picture shows it in the inspector, which has Use as marker / Use as exposure buttons.
steps: Click a picture to inspect it
Change its kind, exposure time or group from the ⋯ menu
serves_tasks: Check how images were automatically sorted into groups and given roles
Confirm the grouping and start automatic detection

features.name: Rotatable region boxes on an image
features.general: Automatically detected rectangles on an image that you can move, resize and rotate. The image is checked one group at a time.
features.specific: Blue strip boxes on the marker picture: drag inside to move, drag an edge or corner handle to resize, drag ↻ to rotate. 'This one is right. Next group' moves through the groups. Adding a box (drag on empty space) and Select + Delete were not tried.
steps: Drag an edge handle to resize
Confirm and move on to the next group
serves_tasks: Adjust the detected region boxes
Review a second image group with tilted regions

features.name: Exposure viewer with levels and saturation overlay
features.general: Switch between several acquisitions of the same sample, stretch the display contrast, and show saturated pixels in colour so they are not used for measurement.
features.specific: Tabs for 2 s / 10 s / 1 min / White light, Black and White sliders (for this row only, or 'Advanced: whole exposure'), Auto, and the Show saturation checkbox, which paints saturated bands red.
steps: Drag the White or Black slider
serves_tasks: Check exposures for saturated signal before choosing which to measure
Adjust display contrast for one row

features.name: Best-acquisition chooser per measurement row
features.general: For each region, show thumbnails of every candidate acquisition labelled as weak, recommended or saturated. Pick one, or go back to the recommended one; the result updates at once.
features.specific: The Exposure panel of a protein box: thumbnails tagged 'weak', '★ recommended' and 'saturated', a Use recommended link, and the row's exposure chip (★ 10 s). The figure row changes immediately.
serves_tasks: Pick the best unsaturated exposure for a row

features.name: Click-to-calibrate ladder marking
features.general: Choose a reference standard from a catalogue, click its bands on an image, and give each one a known value. Once two or more points are marked, unknown positions are estimated by interpolation.
features.specific: A ladder dropdown with about 40 vendor markers and a Marker reference sketch (orange = reference bands). Clicking a band opens a 'what size is this marker band (kDa)?' picker with ladder buttons, an Other field and a suggested next size. Each strip shows a status chip (Not marked / 1 tick marked / MW ready). Ticks appear in the figure and the size of each box is estimated (≈60 kDa). There is also a + Custom / import marker dialog (only viewed).
steps: Mark a second band so the strip becomes 'MW ready'
Read the estimated size on the figure
serves_tasks: Choose the reference standard
Mark reference bands by hand to calibrate size
Define a custom reference standard (only viewed; nothing was saved)

features.name: In-place figure labelling and row annotation
features.general: Edit a composed figure directly: click text to type, press Enter to move to the next label, paste many labels at once, drag rows to reorder, and point at a band with its estimated size.
features.specific: Right-hand figure panel: click 'Protein name' to type, with a formatting popover (size, italic, super/subscript, red), and Enter to jump to the next row. Paste lane names in bulk. Rows reorder by dragging a band, and ◀ Target band shows the estimated kDa.
steps: Click a label on the figure and type
Press Enter to go to the next label
Drag a row to reorder it
serves_tasks: Name each row of the figure
Name the sample lanes
Reorder rows
Mark a target band with its estimated size

features.name: Condition-row grid
features.general: Add a row of per-lane treatment marks under a figure: click each cell to toggle presence or absence of a condition, and name the row.
features.specific: ± Condition row adds a row whose cells you click to set + / −; click the 'Condition' label to rename it (here 'Inhibitor').
steps: Click the row label and type its name
serves_tasks: Add a treatment/condition annotation row

features.name: Multi-column panel layout
features.general: Split a figure into several titled columns and move rows between them by dragging.
features.specific: + Add a layout column creates Column 2 with a 'Drop a region here' slot. You drag a band row across into it, then set the column title and its position (Top), and the column's lane range.
steps: Drag a row into the new column
serves_tasks: Arrange the figure in several columns

features.name: Pre-flight check and multi-format export
features.general: Before exporting, list warnings about missing calibration or reporting caveats, then export the figure as an image or vector file, plus quantification and an audit log.
features.specific: Export PNG (with a dpi choice) and a ▾ menu: TIFF, PowerPoint, SVG, Uncropped originals, Processing log (JSON), Densitometry (CSV), Copy legend text, and a 'Check before export' toggle. The pre-flight dialog lists warnings and notes, with Go back and fix or Export anyway. PNG, SVG, CSV and JSON were exported; TIFF, PowerPoint, Uncropped originals and Copy legend text were not run.
steps: Export anyway or go back and fix
serves_tasks: Export band quantification
Export an audit trail
Run the pre-export check and export the figure image
Export an editable vector figure
